intro.en: Your Main Book. Learn one chapter at a time with Roy. Every new word is explained first.
intro.zh: 你的主课本。和 Roy 老师一章一章地学。每个新词都先解释。

title.en: Reading: Point of View, Perspective and Theme

title.zh: 数学：分数和单位（第 4 章）

points.en: The narrator is the person who TELLS the story.
points.zh: 叙述者就是讲故事的人。

points.en: Sometimes the narrator is in the story. Sometimes the narrator is outside the story.
points.zh: 有时叙述者在故事里，有时在故事外面。

items.zh: 叙述者 = 讲故事的人

points.en: Dialogue = the words the characters SAY. They are inside speech marks " ".
points.zh: 对话 = 人物说的话，写在引号 " " 里。

points.en: "I love swimming!" shouted James. The dialogue is: I love swimming!
points.zh: "I love swimming!" shouted James. 对话是：I love swimming!

remember.en: Dialogue is a trap for clue words. Cover it!
remember.zh: 对话是找线索词的陷阱，要遮住！

quick.q: In a story, words inside speech marks " " are...

why.en: Dialogue = what the characters SAY, inside speech marks.
why.zh: 对话 = 人物说的话，在引号里。

the narrator.en: The narrator tells the story OUTSIDE the speech marks. Words inside them are what characters say: dialogue.
the narrator.zh: 叙述者在引号外讲故事。引号里是人物说的话：对话。

quick.qzh: 故事里引号 " " 里面的话是……

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in R1.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 R1 的重点。

title.en: Point of View: First, Second, Third
title.zh: 视角：第一、第二、第三人称

title.en: Point of view = WHO tells the story

points.en: Point of view tells us WHO the narrator is. We find it with clue words.
points.zh: 视角告诉我们叙述者是谁。我们用线索词来找。

steps.zh: 3. 选第一、第二或第三人称

points.en: The narrator is IN the story and tells it. Clue words: I, me, my, we, us, our.
points.zh: 叙述者在故事里面讲故事。线索词：I、me、my、we、us、our。

points.en: Example: We packed our bags and ran to the bus.
points.zh: 例子：We packed our bags and ran to the bus.

quick.q: "I ran to the bus." Which point of view?

why.en: I, me, my, we = first person.
why.zh: I、me、my、we = 第一人称。

third person.en: Third person uses he, she, they or names. "I" means the narrator is in the story: first person.
third person.zh: 第三人称用 he、she、they 或名字。I 表示叙述者在故事里：第一人称。

quick.qzh: “我跑去赶公交车。”是第几人称？

points.en: The narrator talks straight to YOU, the reader. Clue words: you, your.
points.zh: 叙述者直接对你（读者）说话。线索词：you、your。

points.en: Example: Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!
points.zh: 例子：Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!

points.en: The narrator is OUTSIDE the story. Clue words: he, she, they, him, her, names.
points.zh: 叙述者在故事外面。线索词：he、she、they、him、her、名字。

points.en: Example: Sophie bought a photo card. She smiled all the way home.
points.zh: 例子：Sophie bought a photo card. She smiled all the way home.

quick.q: "She smiled at her friends." Which point of view?

why.en: He, she, they and names = third person.
why.zh: he、she、they 和名字 = 第三人称。

second person.en: Second person talks to YOU. "She" is someone else, so third person.
second person.zh: 第二人称是对“你”说话。she 是别人，所以是第三人称。

quick.qzh: “她对朋友们笑了。”是第几人称？

points.en: "You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
points.zh: "You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.

points.en: "You" is inside the speech marks, so it does not count. Clue words left: Lily, Emma, they. Third person!
points.zh: “You” 在引号里，不算。剩下的线索词：Lily、Emma、they。第三人称！

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in R2.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 R2 的重点。

points.en: Ask: whose FEELINGS or THOUGHTS do I know?
points.zh: 问：我知道谁的感受或想法？

points.en: Feelings words: felt, wished, hoped, was scared, was happy, wanted.
points.zh: 感受词：felt、wished、hoped、was scared、was happy、wanted。

title.en: Objective 客观: like a camera

points.en: We only SEE what people do. We know nobody's feelings.
points.zh: 我们只看到人们做什么，不知道任何人的感受。

points.en: Example: The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped.
points.zh: 例子：The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped.

quick.q: We only see actions, like a camera. That is...

why.en: A camera shows actions, not feelings: objective.
why.zh: 摄像机只拍动作，不拍感受：客观。

limited.en: Limited means we know the feelings of ONE character. A camera shows no feelings at all: objective.
limited.zh: 有限视角是知道一个人物的感受。摄像机完全不显示感受：客观视角。

quick.qzh: 我们只看到动作，就像摄像机一样。这是……

points.en: We know the feelings of ONLY ONE person.
points.zh: 我们只知道一个人的感受。

points.en: Example: Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him. (Only Tom's feelings.)
points.zh: 例子：Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him.（只有 Tom 的感受。）

quick.q: We know the feelings of only ONE character. That is...

why.en: One mind = limited. Every mind = omniscient.
why.zh: 一个人的想法 = 有限；所有人的想法 = 全知。

omniscient.en: Omniscient means we know EVERYONE's feelings (omni = all). One character is limited.
omniscient.zh: 全知视角是知道所有人的感受（omni = 全部）。只知道一个人是有限视角。

quick.qzh: 我们只知道一个人物的感受。这是……

points.en: We know the feelings of EVERYONE. "Omni" means all.
points.zh: 我们知道所有人的感受。omni 的意思是“全部”。

points.en: Example: Daisy felt proud. Emma felt jealous. The teacher was delighted.
points.zh: 例子：Daisy felt proud. Emma felt jealous. The teacher was delighted.

title.en: Draw it: three kinds of narrator

points.en: Draw 3 boxes. In each box, draw the same 3 friends at a K-pop concert.
points.zh: 画 3 个方框，每个方框里画同样的 3 个朋友在看 K-pop 演唱会。

points.en: Box 1, objective: draw a big camera. No thought bubbles.
points.zh: 第 1 框，客观：画一个大摄像机，没有想法泡泡。

points.en: Box 2, limited: ONE thought bubble over ONE friend.
points.zh: 第 2 框，有限：只有一个朋友头上有想法泡泡。

points.en: Box 3, omniscient: a thought bubble over EVERY friend.
points.zh: 第 3 框，全知：每个朋友头上都有想法泡泡。

prompt.en: Draw objective, limited and omniscient as 3 pictures. Label each one.
prompt.zh: 把客观、有限、全知画成 3 幅图，并写上标签。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in R3.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 R3 的重点。

points.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, because of their own life, beliefs and opinions.
points.zh: 看法 = 人物怎样看一件事，因为他们自己的经历、想法和观点。

points.en: Point of view = WHO tells the story. Perspective = HOW someone sees it. They are different!
points.zh: 视角 = 谁讲故事。看法 = 怎样看。它们不一样！

items.en: Daisy: sad, no swimming in the rain
Farmer Tom: happy, plants need rain
items.zh: 农民 Tom：开心，庄稼需要雨

remember.en: Point of view = WHO. Perspective = HOW.
remember.zh: 视角 = 谁；看法 = 怎样看。

quick.q: Two characters see the same rain in different ways. They have different...

why.en: How a character sees something = perspective.
why.zh: 人物怎样看一件事 = 看法。

narrators.en: The narrator is who TELLS the story. Seeing the rain differently is about each character's perspective.
narrators.zh: 叙述者是讲故事的人。对下雨看法不同是每个人物的视角。

quick.qzh: 两个人物对同一场雨有不同的看法。他们有不同的……

points.en: A character's perspective comes from their past experiences, their feelings and what they believe.
points.zh: 人物的看法来自他们过去的经历、感受和相信的事情。

points.en: Emma loves dogs, so a new puppy makes her excited. James was bitten by a dog once, so the same puppy makes him scared.
points.zh: Emma 喜欢狗，所以新小狗让她很兴奋。James 以前被狗咬过，所以同一只小狗让他害怕。

items.en: James: scared, a dog bit him once

quick.q: James was bitten by a dog once. Now he is scared of the new puppy. What shapes his perspective?

why.en: Something that happened to him before changes how he sees dogs now.
why.zh: 他以前的经历改变了他现在怎样看狗。

the weather.en: The weather has nothing to do with dogs. His past experience (being bitten) changed how he sees dogs.
the weather.zh: 天气和狗没有关系。他过去的经历（被咬）改变了他对狗的看法。

quick.qzh: James 以前被狗咬过。现在他害怕新来的小狗。是什么影响了他的看法？

title.en: How to find a character's perspective

points.en: Look at what the character SAYS, DOES, THINKS and FEELS. Then ask: WHY do they feel this way?
points.zh: 看人物说了什么、做了什么、想了什么、感觉怎样。再问：他们为什么这样想？

quick.q: Sophie says, "Shopping for new pens is the best day ever!" What is her perspective on stationery shopping?

why.en: "The best day ever" shows she loves it.
why.zh: "The best day ever"（最棒的一天）说明她很喜欢。

She thinks it is boring..en: Nobody calls a boring day "the best day ever". Her words show she loves it.
She thinks it is boring..zh: 没有人会把无聊的一天说成 the best day ever。她的话说明她很喜欢。

quick.qzh: Sophie 说：“买新笔是最棒的一天！”她对买文具的看法是什么？

points.en: At the festival, Lily loves the loud fireworks. Her dog Max hides under the bed. Same fireworks, different perspectives!
points.zh: 在节日里，Lily 喜欢响亮的烟花。她的狗 Max 躲到床底下。同样的烟花，不同的看法！

points.en: Sentence frame: From ___'s perspective, ___ because ___.
points.zh: 句子模板：From ___'s perspective（从……的看法），___ because（因为）___。

points.en: Example: From Max's perspective, the fireworks are scary because the bangs hurt his ears.
points.zh: 例子：从 Max 的看法，烟花很可怕，因为爆炸声让他的耳朵难受。

remember.en: Point of view = WHO tells the story. Perspective = HOW someone sees it.
remember.zh: 视角 = 谁讲故事；看法 = 怎样看。

quick.q: "The story is told by Tom, using I and me." This sentence is about...

why.en: Who tells the story (Tom, using I) = point of view.
why.zh: 谁讲故事（Tom，用 I）= 视角。

perspective.en: Perspective is how a character FEELS about something. Who tells the story with I and me is point of view.
perspective.zh: 视角是人物对事情的感受。谁用 I 和 me 讲故事是人称（point of view）。

quick.qzh: “故事由 Tom 用 I 和 me 来讲。”这句话说的是……

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in R4.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 R4 的重点。

points.en: A summary tells WHAT HAPPENED in the story, in a few sentences. It uses names.
points.zh: 概要用几句话说故事里发生了什么，会用到名字。

points.en: Example: Emma found a photo card and gave it back to Sophie.
points.zh: 例子：Emma found a photo card and gave it back to Sophie.

points.en: The theme is the LIFE LESSON of the story. It is for everyone, so it has NO names.
points.zh: 主题是故事的人生道理，适用于每个人，所以没有名字。

points.en: Example: Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.
points.zh: 例子：Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.

steps.zh: 给所有人的道理 = 主题

remember.en: Has a name? Probably NOT the theme.

quick.q: A theme has...

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for everyone, so no names.
why.zh: 主题是给每个人的道理，所以不写名字。

the main character's name.en: A name makes it about one story. A theme is a lesson for EVERYONE, so it has no names.
the main character's name.zh: 有名字就只是讲这个故事。主题是给所有人的道理，所以没有名字。

quick.qzh: 主题里……

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in R5.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 R5 的重点。

points.en: Context means the words and sentences AROUND a word.
points.zh: 上下文（context）就是一个词前后的词和句子。

points.en: A context clue is a hint near a new word. It helps you work out what the word means, with no dictionary.
points.zh: 上下文线索是新词附近的提示，帮你猜出这个词的意思，不用查字典。

quick.q: A context clue is...
options: a page at the back of a dictionary
a hint in the words around a new word

why.en: Context = the words around it. The clue is right there in the sentence.
why.zh: 上下文就是词的前后。线索就在句子里。

a page at the back of a dictionary.en: That is a glossary or index. A context clue is in the sentence around the word.
a page at the back of a dictionary.zh: 那是词汇表或索引。上下文线索就在这个词周围的句子里。

quick.qzh: 上下文线索是……

ozh.a hint in the words around a new word: 新词周围的词语给出的提示

title.zh: 线索 1：句子直接告诉你意思

points.en: Sometimes the sentence just tells you. Look for: is, means, which means, or words between commas.
points.zh: 有时句子直接告诉你意思。找这些词：is、means、which means，或者两个逗号中间的话。

points.en: Lily was famished, which means very hungry, after swimming.
points.zh: Lily 游完泳 famished，which means（意思是）非常饿。

remember.en: which means = the meaning is coming!
remember.zh: which means = 意思马上就来！

points.en: A word nearby means the SAME thing.
points.zh: 附近有一个词意思一样。

points.en: The puppy was tiny. It was so small it fit in my hand. (tiny = small)
points.zh: The puppy was tiny. It was so small it fit in my hand.（tiny = small，很小）

quick.q: "The room was silent. It was so quiet you could hear a pin drop." Silent means...

why.en: The next sentence says "so quiet": that is the same meaning.
why.zh: 下一句说 so quiet（很安静），意思一样。

very messy.en: Messy is about being untidy. The clue says "so quiet", which is about sound.
very messy.zh: messy 是乱。线索说 so quiet，是关于声音的。

quick.qzh: “房间很 silent。安静得连针掉下来都听得到。”silent 的意思是……

points.en: Words like but, unlike and however tell you an OPPOSITE is coming.
points.zh: but、unlike、however 这些词告诉你：后面是相反的意思。

points.en: Tom was timid, but his sister was brave. Timid is the opposite of brave: shy and easily scared.
points.zh: Tom was timid, but his sister was brave。timid 和 brave（勇敢）相反：胆小、容易害怕。

quick.q: Which clue word tells you an opposite is coming?

why.en: But = opposite. Such as = examples.
why.zh: but = 相反；such as = 举例。

such as.en: "Such as" gives EXAMPLES, not an opposite.
such as.zh: such as 引出例子，不是相反的意思。

quick.qzh: 哪个线索词告诉你后面是相反的意思？

points.en: Words like such as, for example and like give you examples.
points.zh: such as、for example、like 这些词后面是例子。

points.en: Emma loves stationery, such as gel pens, stickers and notebooks. So stationery = things for writing.
points.zh: Emma loves stationery, such as gel pens, stickers and notebooks。所以 stationery = 文具（写字用的东西）。

points.en: 1. Read the WHOLE sentence, and the one after it.
points.zh: 1. 读完整个句子，还有下一句。

points.en: 2. Find the clue words: which means, but, such as, so.
points.zh: 2. 找线索词：which means、but、such as、so。

points.en: 3. Make a guess.
points.zh: 3. 猜一个意思。

points.en: 4. Put your guess in the sentence. Does it make sense?
points.zh: 4. 把你猜的意思放进句子里，说得通吗？

title.en: Draw it: a word from its clue
title.zh: 画一画：从线索猜出的词

points.en: Read: "After swimming, Lily was FAMISHED, which means very hungry."
points.zh: 读：“After swimming, Lily was FAMISHED, which means very hungry.”

points.en: Draw Lily after swimming, eating a huge bowl of noodles.
points.zh: 画 Lily 游完泳，吃一大碗面。

points.en: Write the word FAMISHED and its meaning. Circle the clue words: which means.
points.zh: 写上 FAMISHED 和它的意思，圈出线索词 which means。

prompt.en: Draw the meaning of FAMISHED and write the clue words.
prompt.zh: 画出 FAMISHED 的意思，写上线索词。

canNow.en: I can now use context clues to work out a new word.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用上下文线索猜出新词的意思。

title.en: What is a fraction? 分数

points.en: A fraction is a PART of a whole. 1/4 of a pizza = 1 piece out of 4 equal pieces.
points.zh: 分数是整体的一部分。1/4 个披萨 = 平均分成 4 块中的 1 块。

example.en: top = parts we have, bottom = equal parts in the whole
example.zh: 上面 = 我们有的份数，下面 = 整体平均分成几份

title.en: Numerator 分子 and denominator 分母

points.en: Numerator = the TOP number. Denominator = the BOTTOM number.
points.zh: 分子 = 上面的数。分母 = 下面的数。

points.en: In 3/4: numerator 3, denominator 4.
points.zh: 在 3/4 里：分子 3，分母 4。

quick.q: In 3/4, the 4 is the...

why.en: Bottom = denominator: how many equal parts.
why.zh: 下面是分母：分成几等份。

numerator.en: The numerator is the TOP number (3), how many parts you have. The bottom is the denominator.
numerator.zh: 分子是上面的数（3），表示有几份。下面的是分母。

points.en: Simplify = make the numbers smaller but keep the same amount. Divide top AND bottom by the same number.
points.zh: 约分 = 让数字变小，但大小不变。分子和分母同时除以同一个数。

points.en: 6/12: divide both by 6 → 1/2.

quick.q: Simplify 4/8.

why.en: Divide top and bottom by 4: 4 ÷ 4 = 1, 8 ÷ 4 = 2, so 1/2.

2/8.en: 2/8 only changes the top. Divide the top AND the bottom by the same number (4): 1/2.
2/8.zh: 2/8 只改了分子。分子和分母要除以同一个数（4）：1/2。

points.en: Improper fraction 假分数: top is BIGGER than the bottom, like 6/5.
points.zh: 假分数：分子比分母大，比如 6/5。

points.en: Mixed number 带分数: a whole number and a fraction, like 1 1/5. 6/5 = 1 1/5 because 6 ÷ 5 = 1 remainder 1.

title.en: A whole number as a fraction

points.en: Any whole number can go over 1: 3 = 3/1, 6 = 6/1.
points.zh: 任何整数都可以写成分母是 1 的分数：3 = 3/1，6 = 6/1。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in M1.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 M1 的重点。

points.en: Multiply the tops. Multiply the bottoms. Then simplify.
points.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，再约分。

example.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，约分

why.en: Top × top: 1 × 1 = 1. Bottom × bottom: 2 × 3 = 6. So 1/6.
why.zh: 分子乘分子：1 × 1 = 1；分母乘分母：2 × 3 = 6。所以是 1/6。

2/5.en: 2/5 adds the tops and the bottoms. Multiply straight across: 1 × 1 = 1, 2 × 3 = 6.
2/5.zh: 2/5 是分子分母都相加了。要直接横着乘：1 × 1 = 1，2 × 3 = 6。

points.en: Draw a rectangle. Split it into 3 equal columns and shade 1 column: that is 1/3.
points.zh: 画一个长方形，竖着分成 3 等份，涂 1 份：这是 1/3。

points.en: Now split it into 2 equal rows and shade the top row in another colour: that is 1/2 of it.
points.zh: 再横着分成 2 等份，用另一种颜色涂上面一行：这是它的 1/2。

points.en: Count the small boxes: 6 in all. The box shaded twice is 1 of 6, so 1/2 × 1/3 = 1/6.
points.zh: 数小格：一共 6 格。涂了两次的格是 6 格中的 1 格，所以 1/2 × 1/3 = 1/6。

prompt.en: Draw 1/2 × 1/3 with a shaded rectangle and write the answer.
prompt.zh: 用涂色的长方形画出 1/2 × 1/3，写出答案。

example.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，约分

points.en: Put the whole number over 1 first: 3 × 2/5 = 3/1 × 2/5 = 6/5 = 1 1/5.
1/2 of 8 = 1/2 × 8 = 4. Half of the bubble tea = 1/2 × the tea.

quick.q: "1/2 of 10" means...

1/2 + 10.en: "Of" means MULTIPLY, not add. Half of 10 is 5, not 10 1/2.
1/2 + 10.zh: of 表示乘，不是加。10 的一半是 5，不是 10 1/2。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in M2.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 M2 的重点。

title.zh: 分数除法：不变、变号、倒过来

points.en: KEEP the first fraction. CHANGE ÷ to ×. FLIP the second fraction. Then multiply.
points.zh: 第一个分数不变。÷ 变 ×。第二个分数倒过来。再相乘。

quick.q: Keep, Change, Flip: 1/2 ÷ 1/4 becomes...

why.en: Keep 1/2, change ÷ to ×, flip 1/4 to 4/1.
why.zh: 保留 1/2，把 ÷ 变成 ×，把 1/4 倒过来变成 4/1。

2/1 × 1/4.en: This flips the FIRST fraction. Keep the first, flip the second.
2/1 × 1/4.zh: 这倒了第一个分数。第一个不变，倒第二个。

quick.qzh: Keep、Change、Flip：1/2 ÷ 1/4 变成……

points.en: 3 ÷ 1/2 asks: how many halves fit in 3? Each whole has 2 halves, so 3 × 2 = 6 halves.
points.zh: 3 ÷ 1/2 问的是：3 里面有几个一半？每个 1 有 2 个一半，所以 3 × 2 = 6 个。

points.en: A whole number can be written as a fraction: 4 = 4/1.
points.zh: 整数可以写成分数：4 = 4/1。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 3/5 × 1/3 = 1/5.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：3/5 × 1/3 = 1/5。

9/5.en: 9/5 is 3/5 × 3: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
9/5.zh: 9/5 是 3/5 × 3，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

points.en: 4 ÷ 2/3: write 4 as 4/1. Keep 4/1, change ÷ to ×, flip 2/3 to 3/2.
Dividing by a fraction smaller than 1 gives a BIGGER answer.
points.zh: 除以一个小于 1 的分数，答案会变大。

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 2/1 × 3/1 = 6.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：2/1 × 3/1 = 6。

2/3.en: 2/3 is 2 × 1/3: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
2/3.zh: 2/3 是 2 × 1/3，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

points.en: Check: 5/12 is about half of 5/6, so 2 of them fit. It makes sense!
points.zh: 检查：5/12 大约是 5/6 的一半，所以能放进 2 个。答案合理！

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 3/4 × 8/3 = 2.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：3/4 × 8/3 = 2。

9/32.en: 9/32 is 3/4 × 3/8: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
9/32.zh: 9/32 是 3/4 × 3/8，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in M3.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 M3 的重点。

points.en: × : "of", "each day ... in 4 days" (the same amount many times).
points.zh: 乘：“of”，“每天……4 天一共”（同样的量很多次）。

points.en: ÷ : "How many ... in ...?", "shared equally", "each gets".
points.zh: 除：“……里有几个？”，“平均分”，“每人分到”。

quick.q: "How many 1/4 cups are in 3 cups?" Do you × or ÷?

why.en: How many ___ in ___ = divide: 3 ÷ 1/4 = 12.

×.en: "How many ___ in ___" asks how many fit inside, which is DIVIDING: 3 ÷ 1/4 = 12.
×.zh: “___ 里有几个 ___”问的是能装几个，用除：3 ÷ 1/4 = 12。

quick.qzh: “3 杯里有几个 1/4 杯？”用乘还是除？

title.en: Check: does my answer make sense?

points.en: Sharing makes each part SMALLER. If 4 friends share 2/3 kg, each gets LESS than 2/3 kg.
points.zh: 平均分会让每份变小。4 个人分 2/3 千克，每人分到的比 2/3 千克少。

points.en: Children come in whole numbers: 1 1/8 children is not possible!
points.zh: 孩子的个数是整数：1 1/8 个孩子是不可能的！

title.en: Multiply: the same amount many times

points.en: Daisy swims 3/4 km each day. How far does she swim in 4 days?
points.zh: Daisy 每天游 3/4 千米。4 天一共游多远？

points.en: Same amount, 4 times: 3/4 × 4 = 12/4 = 3. Answer: 3 km.

quick.q: A puppy eats 2/3 cup of food each day. How much does it eat in 6 days?

why.en: Same amount 6 times: 2/3 × 6 = 12/3 = 4 cups.

1/9 cup.en: 1/9 is 2/3 ÷ 6: it divides. Eating every day for 6 days means multiply: 4 cups.
1/9 cup.zh: 1/9 是 2/3 ÷ 6，除了。6 天每天都吃要用乘：4 杯。

quick.qzh: 小狗每天吃 2/3 杯狗粮。6 天吃多少？

title.en: Divide: how many fit, or share equally
title.zh: 除法：能放几个，或平均分

points.en: Emma has 2 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 1/3 m. How many bows? 2 ÷ 1/3 = 2/1 × 3/1 = 6. Answer: 6 bows.
points.zh: Emma 有 2 米丝带。每个蝴蝶结要 1/3 米。能做几个？2 ÷ 1/3 = 2/1 × 3/1 = 6。答案：6 个。

points.en: 3 friends share 3/4 of a pizza equally. 3/4 ÷ 3 = 3/4 × 1/3 = 3/12 = 1/4. Answer: 1/4 of a pizza each.

quick.q: A shop has 3 kg of sweets. It puts them in bags of 1/4 kg. How many bags?

3/4 bag.en: 3/4 is 3 × 1/4: it multiplied. "How many bags" means how many 1/4 fit in 3: divide.
3/4 bag.zh: 3/4 是 3 × 1/4，乘了。“几袋”是问 3 里有几个 1/4：除。

quick.qzh: 商店有 3 千克糖果，每袋装 1/4 千克。能装几袋？

points.en: 2/5 of 20 stickers = 2/5 × 20 = 40/5 = 8 stickers.
Check: a fraction of something is LESS than the whole, so 8 is less than 20. Good!
points.zh: 检查：一个东西的几分之几比整体少，8 比 20 少。对了！

quick.q: Lily has 12 K-pop cards. She gives away 3/4 of them. How many cards does she give away?

why.en: 3/4 of 12 = 3/4 × 12 = 36/4 = 9 cards. (16 comes from dividing by 3/4.)

16 cards.en: 16 is 12 ÷ 3/4: it divides. She can't give away more than the 12 she has. "Of" means multiply.
16 cards.zh: 16 是 12 ÷ 3/4，除了。她不可能送出比她的 12 张还多。of 表示乘。

quick.qzh: Lily 有 12 张 K-pop 小卡，她送出了其中的 3/4。她送出了几张？

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in M4.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 M4 的重点。

title.en: Step 1: change mixed numbers to improper fractions
title.zh: 第 1 步：把带分数变成假分数

points.en: A mixed number has a whole number and a fraction: 2 1/3 means 2 wholes and 1/3 more.
points.zh: 带分数有整数部分和分数部分：2 1/3 就是 2 个整体再加 1/3。

points.en: To change it: bottom × whole, then + top. Keep the same bottom.
points.zh: 变法：分母 × 整数，再 + 分子，分母不变。

remember.zh: 分母 × 整数 + 分子，分母不变

quick.q: Change 1 1/2 to an improper fraction.

2/2.en: 2/2 forgets to add the 1 on top: 1 × 2 + 1 = 3. And 2/2 is just 1 whole.

quick.qzh: 把 1 1/2 变成假分数。

points.en: Step 1: change each mixed number to an improper fraction.
points.zh: 第 1 步：把每个带分数变成假分数。

points.en: Step 2: tops × tops, bottoms × bottoms (the same as M2).
points.zh: 第 2 步：分子 × 分子，分母 × 分母（和 M2 一样）。

points.en: Step 3: simplify, then change back to a mixed number.
points.zh: 第 3 步：约分，再变回带分数。

why.en: Change mixed numbers to improper fractions first: 5/2 × 2/1. Multiply tops and bottoms: 10/2 = 5.
why.zh: 先把带分数变成假分数：5/2 × 2/1。分子乘分子、分母乘分母：10/2 = 5。

4 1/2.en: 4 1/2 multiplies only the whole number 2 by 2 and forgets to multiply the 1/2 too. Change to improper fractions: 5/2 × 2/1 = 5.
4 1/2.zh: 4 1/2 只把整数 2 乘了 2，忘了 1/2 也要乘。要先变成假分数：5/2 × 2/1 = 5。

title.en: Trap: do not multiply the parts on their own
title.zh: 陷阱：不要把两部分分开乘

points.en: Wrong way: 1 1/2 × 2 1/3, do 1 × 2 = 2 and 1/2 × 1/3 = 1/6, and say 2 1/6. That misses a lot!
Always change to improper fractions FIRST.
points.zh: 一定要先变成假分数。

points.en: Check by estimating: 1 1/2 is about 1.5 and 2 1/3 is about 2, so the answer is about 3. 3 1/2 makes sense.
points.zh: 用估算检查：1 1/2 约等于 1.5，2 1/3 约等于 2，答案大约是 3。3 1/2 是合理的。

remember.en: improper first, then multiply, then estimate to check
remember.zh: 先变假分数，再乘，再估算检查

title.zh: 故事：给朋友做珍珠奶茶

points.en: Daisy uses 1 1/2 cups of milk for one jug of bubble tea. She makes 3 jugs. How much milk?
points.zh: Daisy 做一壶珍珠奶茶用 1 1/2 杯牛奶。她做 3 壶。一共要多少牛奶？

points.en: 3 jugs of 1 1/2 cups means ×.
points.zh: 3 壶、每壶 1 1/2 杯，所以用 ×。

quick.q: Tom swims 2 1/4 km each day for 2 days. How far?

why.en: Same distance each day = multiply: 9/4 × 2/1 = 18/4 = 9/2 = 4 1/2 km.

4 1/4 km.en: 4 1/4 multiplies only the 2 and forgets to double the 1/4: 1/4 × 2 = 1/2.

quick.qzh: Tom 每天游 2 1/4 公里，游了 2 天。一共游了多远？

canNow.en: I can now multiply mixed numbers and check my answer by estimating.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数乘法，并用估算检查答案。

points.en: Step 1: change each mixed number to an improper fraction (M5).
points.zh: 第 1 步：把每个带分数变成假分数（M5）。

points.en: Step 2: Keep, Change, Flip (M3). Keep the first, change ÷ to ×, flip the second.
points.zh: 第 2 步：不变、变号、倒过来（M3）。第一个不变，÷ 变 ×，第二个倒过来。

points.en: Step 3: tops × tops, bottoms × bottoms.
points.zh: 第 3 步：分子 × 分子，分母 × 分母。

points.en: Step 4: simplify.
points.zh: 第 4 步：约分。

remember.en: improper first, THEN Keep, Change, Flip
remember.zh: 先变假分数，再“不变、变号、倒过来”

quick.q: 2 1/2 ÷ 1 1/4: what do you do FIRST?

why.en: You can only flip a fraction, so change 1 1/4 to 5/4 first.
why.zh: 只能把分数倒过来，所以先把 1 1/4 变成 5/4。

flip 1 1/4 straight away.en: You can only flip a FRACTION. A mixed number must become an improper fraction first: 1 1/4 = 5/4.
flip 1 1/4 straight away.zh: 只能倒分数。带分数要先变成假分数：1 1/4 = 5/4。

ozh.change both to improper fractions: 把两个数都变成假分数

points.en: Emma has 4 1/2 m of ribbon. Each bow needs 3/4 m. How many bows can she make?
points.zh: Emma 有 4 1/2 米丝带。每个蝴蝶结要 3/4 米。她能做几个蝴蝶结？

points.en: "How many ... in ...?" means ÷.
points.zh: “……里有几个……？”就用 ÷。

quick.q: How many 1/2 cups are in 2 1/2 cups?

why.en: Change to improper fractions, then Keep, Change, Flip: 5/2 × 2/1 = 5.
why.zh: 先变成假分数，再 Keep、Change、Flip：5/2 × 2/1 = 5。

1 1/4.en: 1 1/4 is 2 1/2 × 1/2: it multiplied without flipping. Keep, Change, Flip.
1 1/4.zh: 1 1/4 是 2 1/2 × 1/2，没有倒过来就乘了。要 Keep、Change、Flip。

quick.qzh: 2 1/2 杯里有几个 1/2 杯？

title.en: Check: does my answer make sense?

points.en: Dividing by a number BIGGER than 1 gives a smaller answer: 3 1/2 ÷ 1 3/4 = 2.
points.zh: 除以比 1 大的数，答案会变小：3 1/2 ÷ 1 3/4 = 2。

points.en: Dividing by a number SMALLER than 1 gives a bigger answer: 4 1/2 ÷ 3/4 = 6.
points.zh: 除以比 1 小的数，答案会变大：4 1/2 ÷ 3/4 = 6。

remember.en: ÷ by more than 1 → smaller; ÷ by less than 1 → bigger
remember.zh: 除以大于 1 的数 → 变小；除以小于 1 的数 → 变大

quick.q: 6 ÷ 1/2 will be...

why.en: 1/2 is less than 1, so the answer is bigger: 6 ÷ 1/2 = 12.

smaller than 6.en: Dividing by a number LESS than 1 gives a bigger answer: there are 12 halves in 6.
smaller than 6.zh: 除以小于 1 的数，答案会更大：6 里有 12 个一半。

canNow.en: I can now divide mixed numbers and check my answer with ×.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以做带分数除法，并用乘法检查答案。

points.en: Length: 1 foot (ft) = 12 inches (in). 1 yard (yd) = 3 feet.
points.zh: 长度：1 英尺 (ft) = 12 英寸 (in)。1 码 (yd) = 3 英尺。

points.en: Weight: 1 pound (lb) = 16 ounces (oz). 1 ton (T) = 2,000 pounds.
Capacity (how much a cup holds): 1 cup (c) = 8 fluid ounces (fl oz). 1 pint (pt) = 2 cups. 1 quart (qt) = 2 pints. 1 gallon (gal) = 4 quarts.
points.zh: 容量（能装多少）：1 杯 (c) = 8 液量盎司 (fl oz)。1 品脱 (pt) = 2 杯。1 夸脱 (qt) = 2 品脱。1 加仑 (gal) = 4 夸脱。

quick.q: 1 foot = ? inches

why.en: 1 foot is 12 inches. (10 is for cm and mm.)
why.zh: 1 英尺 = 12 英寸。（10 是厘米和毫米。）

10.en: 10 is for metric units (10 mm = 1 cm). A foot is 12 inches.
10.zh: 10 是公制单位用的（10 毫米 = 1 厘米）。1 英尺是 12 英寸。

quick.qzh: 1 英尺 = ? 英寸

points.en: Small units are tiny, so you need MORE of them. Multiply.
points.zh: 小单位很小，需要的个数更多，所以用乘法。

quick.q: 2 lb = ? oz

why.en: Big to small: multiply. 2 × 16 = 32 oz.

8 oz.en: 8 is 16 ÷ 2: it divides. Pounds are bigger, so 2 lb is MORE ounces: 2 × 16.
8 oz.zh: 8 是 16 ÷ 2，除了。磅比较大，2 磅换成盎司会更多：2 × 16。

quick.qzh: 2 磅 = ? 盎司

points.en: Big units are large, so you need FEWER of them. Divide (or multiply by a fraction).
points.zh: 大单位很大，需要的个数更少，所以用除法（或乘一个分数）。

quick.q: 6 ft = ? yd

why.en: Small to big: divide. 6 ÷ 3 = 2 yd.

18 yd.en: 18 is 6 × 3: it multiplied. Feet are small, so you get FEWER yards: 6 ÷ 3.
18 yd.zh: 18 是 6 × 3，乘了。英尺是小单位，换成码会更少：6 ÷ 3。

quick.qzh: 6 英尺 = ? 码

title.en: Check: big number or small number?

points.en: Going to a SMALLER unit: the number gets BIGGER (3 ft → 36 in).
points.zh: 换成更小的单位：数字变大（3 ft → 36 in）。

points.en: Going to a BIGGER unit: the number gets SMALLER (24 oz → 1 1/2 lb).
points.zh: 换成更大的单位：数字变小（24 oz → 1 1/2 lb）。

remember.en: small unit, big number; big unit, small number
remember.zh: 单位小，数字大；单位大，数字小

quick.q: Change 48 inches to feet. The number will get...

why.en: Feet are bigger than inches, so the number gets smaller: 48 ÷ 12 = 4 ft.
why.zh: 英尺比英寸大，所以数字变小：48 ÷ 12 = 4 英尺。

bigger.en: A foot holds 12 inches, so you need FEWER feet than inches: 48 ÷ 12 = 4.
bigger.zh: 1 英尺有 12 英寸，所以英尺数比英寸数少：48 ÷ 12 = 4。

quick.qzh: 把 48 英寸换成英尺，数字会变……

canNow.en: I can now change between feet and inches, pounds and ounces, and cups, pints, quarts and gallons.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以换算英尺和英寸、磅和盎司，以及杯、品脱、夸脱和加仑。

points.en: A complete sentence has WHO (subject) + DOES WHAT (verb). It starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
points.zh: 完整的句子有“谁”（主语）+“做什么”（动词），以大写字母开头，以句号结尾。

points.en: A run-on = two complete sentences joined with nothing, or with only a comma.
points.zh: 连写句 = 两个完整的句子连在一起，中间没有东西，或者只有逗号。

points.en: Fix 1: full stop + capital letter. Fix 2: comma + and / but / so.
points.zh: 改法 1：句号 + 大写。改法 2：逗号 + and / but / so。

main.en: The pool was cold I jumped in.
main.zh: The pool was cold I jumped in.

example.en: → The pool was cold, but I jumped in.
example.zh: → The pool was cold, but I jumped in.

quick.q: "I love swimming I go every day." This is...

why.en: Two sentences squashed with no full stop or joining word. Fix: I love swimming, so I go every day.
why.zh: 两个句子挤在一起，没有句号也没有连词。改正：I love swimming, so I go every day.

a complete sentence.en: It has TWO complete sentences (I love swimming / I go every day) with nothing between them, so it is a run-on.
a complete sentence.zh: 它有两个完整的句子（I love swimming / I go every day），中间什么都没有，所以是连写句。

quick.qzh: “I love swimming I go every day.”这是……

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in E1.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 E1 的重点。

points.en: Add -ion to a verb (doing word) to make a noun (thing word): discuss → discussion.
points.zh: 在动词后加 -ion 变成名词：discuss → discussion。

points.en: Ends in e? Drop the e first: evaluate → evaluation, operate → operation.
points.zh: 以 e 结尾？先去掉 e：evaluate → evaluation，operate → operation。

quick.q: Evaluate + -ion = ?

why.en: Drop the e, then add -ion.
why.zh: 先去掉 e，再加 -ion。

evaluateion.en: When a word ends in e, drop the e before -ion: no "eion".
evaluateion.zh: 以 e 结尾的词加 -ion 前要去掉 e：不会有 eion。

quick.qzh: Evaluate + -ion = ？（选正确的拼写）

points.en: A verb is a doing word: We discuss the trip.
points.zh: 动词是表示动作的词：We discuss the trip.（我们讨论旅行。）

points.en: A noun is a thing word: We had a discussion.
points.zh: 名词是表示事物的词：We had a discussion.（我们进行了讨论。）

points.en: Adding -ion turns the verb into a noun. The -tion or -sion ending says "shun".
points.zh: 加 -ion 让动词变成名词。-tion 或 -sion 读作 "shun"。

quick.q: In "We had a long ___ about the trip", which word fits?

why.en: After "a long" we need a thing word (noun): discussion.
why.zh: "a long" 后面要用名词：discussion。

discuss.en: "Discuss" is a verb (an action). After "a long" we need a noun (a thing): discussion.
discuss.zh: discuss 是动词（动作）。a long 后面要名词（东西）：discussion。

quick.qzh: 在“We had a long ___ about the trip”里，哪个词合适？

points.en: If the verb ends in -ct, -st or -ss, just add -ion. Do not change anything.
points.zh: 如果动词以 -ct、-st 或 -ss 结尾，直接加 -ion，别的不变。

quick.q: digest + ion = ?

why.en: digest ends in -st, so just add -ion.
why.zh: digest 以 -st 结尾，直接加 -ion。

digestation.en: There is no -ate in digest. Just add -ion: digestion.

quick.qzh: digest + ion = ？（选正确的拼写）

title.en: Rule 2: drop the e, then add -ion

points.en: If the verb ends in -ate, drop the final e, then add -ion.
points.zh: 如果动词以 -ate 结尾，先去掉最后的 e，再加 -ion。

quick.q: congratulate + ion = ?

why.en: Drop the e, then add -ion.
why.zh: 先去掉 e，再加 -ion。

congratulateion.en: Drop the e before -ion: congratulat + ion.
congratulateion.zh: 加 -ion 前去掉 e：congratulat + ion。

quick.qzh: congratulate + ion = ？（选正确的拼写）

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in E2.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 E2 的重点。

title.en: The 5 parts of a narrative speech
title.zh: 个人经历演讲的 5 个部分

points.en: 1 Introduction: grab attention (Have you ever...?). 2 Beginning: when, where, who. 3 Middle: the problem or surprise.
points.zh: 1 开场：吸引听众。2 开始：时间、地点、人物。3 中间：问题或惊喜。

points.en: 4 End: how it ended and how you felt. 5 Conclusion: what you learned (This experience taught me that...).
points.zh: 4 结尾：结果和感受。5 总结：学到了什么。

quick.q: A narrative speech tells...

why.en: Narrative = a story, with a beginning, middle and end.
why.zh: narrative = 故事，有开头、中间和结尾。

a list of facts.en: A list of facts is an information talk. Narrative means a STORY.
a list of facts.zh: 列事实是说明性演讲。narrative 是讲故事。

quick.qzh: 叙事演讲讲的是……

points.en: Start with a hook: a question, a sound, or a surprising sentence.
points.zh: 用一个“钩子”开始：一个问题、一个声音或一句让人惊讶的话。

points.en: Example: Have you ever jumped into a pool that felt colder than ice?
points.zh: 例子：你有没有跳进过一个比冰还冷的泳池？

quick.q: Which is the best attention grabber?
options: Have you ever lost something very special?
My speech is about a day.

why.en: A question makes the audience think about their own life, so they want to listen.
why.zh: 问题让听众想到自己的经历，所以他们想听下去。

My speech is about a day..en: This just states the topic. It does not make the audience curious or think about themselves.
My speech is about a day..zh: 这只是说出题目，不会让听众好奇或联想到自己。

quick.qzh: 哪一句最能吸引注意？

ozh.Have you ever lost something very specia: 你有没有丢过很特别的东西？
我的演讲是关于某一天的。

points.en: Use time words so the audience can follow: First, Then, Suddenly, After that, Finally.
points.zh: 用时间词让听众跟得上：First（首先）、Then（然后）、Suddenly（突然）、After that（之后）、Finally（最后）。

points.en: Add feeling words: nervous, excited, proud, surprised.
points.zh: 加上感受词：nervous（紧张）、excited（兴奋）、proud（骄傲）、surprised（惊讶）。

quick.q: Which time word tells the audience a problem or surprise is coming?

why.en: Suddenly = something happens fast and unexpected.
why.zh: Suddenly（突然）= 一件意想不到的事很快发生。

Finally.en: "Finally" shows the END is coming, not a surprise.
Finally.zh: finally 表示快结束了，不是意外。

quick.qzh: 哪个时间词告诉听众问题或意外要来了？

points.en: Look at your audience. Speak loudly and slowly. Pause after important parts.
points.zh: 看着听众。大声、慢慢地说。重要的地方停一下。

points.en: Use a small note card with key words. Do not read every word. Practise 3 times at home.
points.zh: 用一张写着关键词的小卡片，不要每个字都读。在家练习 3 次。

quick.q: When you give your speech, you should...
options: read every word from the paper with your head down
look at your audience and speak slowly

why.en: Eye contact and a slow, clear voice help people listen.
why.zh: 看着听众、清楚慢慢地说，大家更容易听懂。

read every word from the paper with your.en: With your head down, the audience can't hear you well or feel you are talking to them.
read every word from the paper with your.zh: 低着头念，听众听不清，也感觉不到你在跟他们说话。

quick.qzh: 做演讲时，你应该……

ozh.read every word from the paper with your: 低着头把纸上的每个字念出来

canNow.en: I can now explain the key ideas in E3.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 E3 的重点。

points.en: A conjunction is a JOINING word. It joins two words, or two sentences, into one.
points.zh: 连词（conjunction）是用来连接的词。它把两个词或两个句子连成一个。

points.en: Daisy likes K-pop. Daisy likes swimming. → Daisy likes K-pop AND swimming.
points.zh: Daisy likes K-pop. Daisy likes swimming. → Daisy likes K-pop AND swimming.

points.en: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So. The first letters spell FANBOYS.
points.zh: For、And、Nor、But、Or、Yet、So。首字母拼成 FANBOYS。

points.en: and = adds more. but = something different or a surprise. or = a choice. so = what happened next (a result).
points.zh: and = 再加上；but = 不一样或意外；or = 选择；so = 所以（结果）。

quick.q: "It was raining, ___ we stayed inside." Which one?

why.en: "So" shows a RESULT: the rain caused us to stay inside.
why.zh: so 表示结果：下雨导致我们待在屋里。

or.en: "Or" gives a choice. Here one thing caused the other.
or.zh: or 是选择。这里是一件事导致另一件事。

quick.qzh: “下雨了，___ 我们待在屋里。”选哪一个？

title.zh: 表示原因、时间、条件的词

points.en: because = gives the reason (why).
points.zh: because = 说原因（为什么）。

points.en: when, before, after, until = tell you WHEN.
points.zh: when、before、after、until = 说什么时候。

points.en: if = a condition. although = even though, a surprise.
points.zh: if = 如果（条件）；although = 虽然（让人意外）。

points.en: Tom was hungry because he missed breakfast.
points.zh: Tom was hungry because he missed breakfast.（因为他没吃早饭）

quick.q: "Wash your hands ___ you eat." Which one?

why.en: "Before" tells WHEN: wash first, then eat.
why.zh: before 表示时间：先洗手，再吃饭。

because.en: "Because" gives a reason. Eating is not the reason for washing; the sentence is about order.
because.zh: because 给出原因。吃饭不是洗手的原因；句子讲的是先后顺序。

quick.qzh: “吃饭 ___ 要洗手。”选哪一个？

points.en: When and, but or so joins TWO full sentences, put a comma before it.
points.zh: 当 and、but 或 so 连接两个完整的句子时，在它前面加逗号。

points.en: I love K-pop, so I bought a photo card.
points.zh: I love K-pop, so I bought a photo card.

points.en: No comma for two words: pens and pencils.
points.zh: 只连两个词时不用逗号：pens and pencils。

remember.en: Two full sentences + and/but/so = comma first.
remember.zh: 两个完整句子 + and/but/so = 前面加逗号。

canNow.en: I can now join sentences with the right conjunction.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用正确的连词连接句子。

title.zh: 后缀 -er 和 -or，还有一个习语

points.en: A suffix is a group of letters added at the END of a word.
points.zh: 后缀（suffix）是加在词尾的几个字母。

points.en: -er and -or both mean "a person who does it": teach → teacher, act → actor.
points.zh: -er 和 -or 都表示“做这件事的人”：teach → teacher（老师），act → actor（演员）。

points.en: Most everyday words use -er: teacher, singer, painter, baker.
points.zh: 大多数日常的词用 -er：teacher、singer、painter、baker。

points.en: Words ending in -ate drop the e and add -or: investigate → investigator, operate → operator.
points.zh: 以 -ate 结尾的词去掉 e 加 -or：investigate → investigator，operate → operator。

points.en: Words ending in -ct add -or: act → actor, instruct → instructor.
points.zh: 以 -ct 结尾的词加 -or：act → actor，instruct → instructor。

points.en: Watch the spelling: swim → swimmer (double m), bake → baker (drop the e).
points.zh: 注意拼写：swim → swimmer（双写 m），bake → baker（去掉 e）。

quick.q: A person who instructs is an...

why.en: Instruct ends in -ct, so add -or: instructor.
why.zh: instruct 以 -ct 结尾，所以加 -or：instructor。

instructer.en: Words ending in -ct (instruct, act) take -OR for the person.
instructer.zh: 以 -ct 结尾的词（instruct、act）表示人时加 -or。

quick.qzh: 教别人的人是……（选正确的拼写）

title.en: Idiom: go out on a limb
title.zh: 习语：go out on a limb

points.en: An idiom is a group of words with a meaning different from the single words.
points.zh: 习语（idiom）是一组词，整体意思和单个词的意思不一样。

points.en: A limb is a big branch of a tree. Out on a thin branch, it might break!
points.zh: limb 是树的大树枝。爬到细树枝的末端，树枝可能会断！

points.en: Go out on a limb = take a risk by saying or doing something others may not agree with.
points.zh: go out on a limb = 冒险说或做一件别人可能不同意的事。

points.en: Sophie went out on a limb and said her favourite group would win the award.
points.zh: Sophie went out on a limb（冒险说）她最喜欢的组合会得奖。

quick.q: "Go out on a limb" means...

why.en: It is an idiom. It is about taking a risk, not about real trees.
why.zh: 这是习语，意思是冒险，不是真的爬树。

climb a real tree.en: An idiom does not mean its exact words. "Out on a limb" means taking a risk.
climb a real tree.zh: 习语不是字面意思。out on a limb 是冒险。

quick.qzh: Go out on a limb 的意思是……

title.en: Draw it: go out on a limb
title.zh: 画一画：go out on a limb

points.en: Draw a big tree. Draw a person climbing far out on a thin branch (a limb).
points.zh: 画一棵大树，画一个人爬到一根细树枝（limb）的末端。

points.en: Give the person a speech bubble with a brave idea that others may not agree with.
points.zh: 给这个人画一个说话泡泡，写一个别人可能不同意的大胆想法。

points.en: Write under it: go out on a limb = take a risk.
points.zh: 在下面写：go out on a limb = 冒险。

prompt.en: Draw the idiom "go out on a limb" and write what it means.
prompt.zh: 画出习语 go out on a limb，并写出它的意思。

labels: go out on a limb = take a risk

canNow.en: I can now choose -er or -or and explain "go out on a limb".
canNow.zh: 我现在会选 -er 或 -or，并能解释 go out on a limb。

points.en: Fiction means a made-up story. It did not really happen.
points.zh: fiction（虚构）就是编出来的故事，不是真的发生过。

points.en: A narrative is a story told in order: beginning, middle, end.
points.zh: narrative（记叙文）就是按顺序讲的故事：开头、中间、结尾。

quick.q: A fictional narrative is...

why.en: Fiction = made up.
why.zh: fiction = 编出来的。

a true diary.en: A true diary is NON-fiction. Fiction is made up.
a true diary.zh: 真实的日记是非虚构的。虚构是编出来的。

quick.qzh: 虚构的叙事是……

points.en: Characters: WHO is in the story.
points.zh: 人物（characters）：故事里有谁。

points.en: Setting: WHERE and WHEN it happens.
points.zh: 背景（setting）：在哪里、什么时候发生。

points.en: Problem: what goes wrong.
points.zh: 问题（problem）：出了什么问题。

points.en: Events: what the characters do, step by step.
points.zh: 事件（events）：人物一步一步做了什么。

points.en: Solution: how the problem is fixed at the end.
points.zh: 解决（solution）：最后问题怎样解决。

quick.q: "At a busy night market in winter" is the...

why.en: Where and when = setting.
why.zh: 在哪里、什么时候 = 背景。

problem.en: The problem is what goes wrong. "Where and when" is the setting.
problem.zh: 问题是出了什么错。“在哪里、什么时候”是背景。

quick.qzh: “冬天一个热闹的夜市”是故事的……

points.en: A draft is a first try. It does not have to be perfect.
points.zh: 草稿（draft）是第一次尝试，不用完美。

points.en: Plan the 5 parts in short notes, then write one paragraph for each.
points.zh: 先用短短的笔记计划 5 个部分，再每部分写一段。

points.en: Show feelings: "Her hands shook" is better than "She was scared".
points.zh: 写出感受：“她的手在发抖”比“她很害怕”更好。

remember.en: Plan, draft, then check capitals and full stops.
remember.zh: 先计划，再打草稿，最后检查大写和句号。

canNow.en: I can now plan and draft a story with all 5 parts.
canNow.zh: 我现在会计划并写出有 5 个部分的故事草稿。
